title: Exotic Peppery Japanese Azuki Beans Zenzai
description: A traditional Tohoku dessert featuring azuki beans, turmeric powder, and a hint of peppery flavor, now vegan-friendly and kid-friendly, with a shattering texture from the mantecare-emulsify method.
instructions: Rinse the azuki beans and soak them in water for 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the azuki beans, then transfer them to a pot with 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender.
Drain the beans and mash them in a bowl with a fork.
In a separate pot, combine the coconut milk, maple syrup, turmeric powder, black pepper, and salt, and whisk until smooth.
Bring the coconut milk mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and lemon juice until smooth.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the coconut milk mixture and whisk until thickened.
Stir in the mashed azuki beans and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
